limitations: Model coverage is not a live row or object inventory and proves no erasure.
Capture object namespaces and versions before deleting references; include incoming, sealed and unselected copies.
Inbound mail may be linked by alias or document IDs while household_id is null; household FK cascade is insufficient.
Account deletion must include user/profile/preferences, idempotency responses and actor/target audit references, not just one household.
Outbox, audit and inbound rows may survive household deletion; never resume their processing.
Audit content is erased except an explicitly authorized bounded security hold; minimal receipt evidence cannot contain the erased content.
Anonymous auth counters have TTL and no direct user relation; retention/sweep verification remains necessary.
Global vendors must contain public institutional data only; they are not permission to retain personal facts.
Provider removal, suppression/Stripe retention and backups require independent receipts; none are inferred from local cascades.
Queue expiry, opaque identifiers and successful delete acknowledgements alone do not prove erasure.

ADR-018 journals deliberately survive deletion; their identity-link retention, minimal final receipt and erasure need an independently verified policy. New journal tables are not an authorization to retain identifiers indefinitely.

Account-security challenges contain pseudonymous user/session/factor IDs. Five-minute challenge expiry is not a journal-erasure policy; bounded holds and independently authorized retirement remain required before hosted activation.

TEST billing bindings/notices are scoped provider references, not proof of provider account deletion. Preserve deduplication through the reviewed replay horizon; do not cascade or indefinitely retain personal linkage.

Local encrypted export files are not complete user exports. Revocation/expiry checks prove local file absence only; crashed pending ciphertext, backup copies, key custody and notification delivery need separate lifecycle evidence.

Local export publication journals bind ciphertext digest/owner/expiry and survive physical cleanup; terminal revocation cannot be reset. Journal retention requires ADR-019 authority; expiry is not journal-erasure authorization.

Internal TEST reconciliation intents are bounded opaque work, distinct from provider events; safe subscription state is exportable but lease/work capabilities are excluded. Fence, independent inventory and ADR-019 restore/retirement rules apply; no automatic purge.
Plan catalog and local activation contain no tenant IDs or personal content. Runtime roles cannot edit them; local TEST activation defaults false. They are not deletion evidence.

ADR-021 clean custody and processing journals are local-only; review deadline is a hold, not deletion. Count retained objects until independent absence; original bytes and exact-once charges require inventory/restore coverage. No final receipt or cloud durability claim.
Immutable synthetic result/review journals bind original processing authority. Their retention and quota-preserving retirement remain gated by ADR-019; no cascade or final receipt.

Local Plaid subjects/exchanges/Items/credentials/routes/cursors/webhooks/accounts/transactions are inventoried immediately; encrypted credentials, cursors, lease and provider internals are excluded from all exports. Local custody destruction after removal is not provider deletion evidence; derived financial records are retained after unlink pending a product retention decision. Provider absence, backups and journal retirement remain unproven.
